The owner's initial ~10 count was reproduced and traced: 1) manifest_service hardcoded only 10 blocks in CORE_INTERNALIZED_BLOCKS, 403-quarantining the rest; 2) 12 shader blocks had dummy play: function() {} stubs that overwrote shader_fallback.js; 3) data-chart and weight-wave had timing/font setup gaps; 4) 40 blocks are legitimately blocked by trademark/likeness (15), external GIS (5), or unvendored 3D/proprietary models (20). Agent 4 repaired the shader timelines, font bindings, and offline GSAP layer, elevating live MS Edge animated previews from 10 to 131.
